title: Federated Learning for LLMs over Mobile Networks: Issues and Solutions in the RAN Transport
abstract: arXiv:2610.01304v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated LLM fine-tuning enables large models to be adapted using private and geographically distributed data at the network edge, creating recurring and deadline-sensitive communication workloads across access and transport networks. This challenge is particularly relevant in mobile RANs, where wireless variability, mobility, and device heterogeneity cause model updates to arrive asynchronously. Although these updates belong to the same learning round and share a common destination and deadline, conventional transport networks treat them as independent device-originated flows, hiding their underlying structure and limiting the ability to efficiently provision transport resources. This mismatch is particularly problematic for optical circuit switching and all-photonics transport, which benefit from predictable and schedulable traffic demands. translated_title: 面向移动网络的LLM联邦学习：无线接入网传输中的问题与解决方案
translated_abstract: 联邦LLM微调使得大型模型能够利用网络边缘私有且地理分布的数据进行适配，从而在接入网和传输网中产生周期性的、对截止时间敏感的通信工作负载。这一挑战在移动无线接入网（RAN）中尤为突出，因为无线环境的可变性、移动性和设备异构性会导致模型更新异步到达。尽管这些更新属于同一学习轮次，并共享共同的目的地和截止时间，但传统传输网络将其视为相互独立的、由设备发起的数据流，掩盖了其底层结构，限制了高效配置传输资源的能力。这种不匹配对于光电路交换和全光传输而言尤其成问题，因为这类技术依赖于可预测、可调度的流量需求。我们认为，未来的RAN应当作为学习感知的流量整形器，通过暴露通信……
tldr: 论文指出联邦LLM微调产生的模型更新具有同轮次、同目的地、同截止时间的共同结构，而传统传输网络将其视为独立数据流的做法掩盖了这一结构，并提出未来移动RAN应充当“学习感知”的流量整形器，以支持光电路交换和全光传输等依赖可预测流量的技术高效配置传输资源。
en_tdlr: The paper argues that model updates in federated LLM fine-tuning share a common structure (same round, destination, and deadline) that conventional transport networks overlook, and proposes that future mobile RANs should act as learning-aware traffic shapers to enable efficient transport resource provisioning for optical circuit switching and all-photonics networks.
